text:
maria (sales): Opening thread for Stormhold POC perf verification. Prospect asks for a concise results writeup they can share with procurement: target 500 qps sustained for chat generation with p95 <= 220ms on 256-token contexts. Also need a short note on cost and fallback behavior. Can SE/perf own?

kai (se): I can run orchestration. Plan: primary Dedicated-1 pool (4x A100 equiv) and a hosted fallback path. Which model variants and workload splits?

oliver (stormhold): We're validating rwd-7b-fp16 and rwd-3b-quant. Workload: 80% chat completions (~30 token responses), 20% batched embeddings (batch size 512). A handful (~1.5%) of prompts contain tokenized PHI; if so we need Private + customer KMS for that subset.

jo (perf): Proposed minimal test plan to give procurement what they need: warmup 20m @150 qps, ramp 150->500 over 10m, sustain 60m @500 qps, then 3x 1kqps 20s spikes. Collect p50/p95/p99, per-token time, batch size distribution, GPU util, queue depth. Export CSV+PNG to s3. Enable continuous batching and KV prefix cache.

kai (se): Add a traffic-split check: 10% to quant variant to verify parity. Also include a controlled worker preempt (kill one pod) during sustain to demonstrate graceful degradation.

maria (sales): Procurement wants a 72h run cost ballpark + an ops estimate if we scale to 1k qps sustained. Also timeline for Private/KMS onboarding if PHI tests are required.

jo (perf): Quick ballpark (very rough): 72h Dedicated run ~ $2.8k - $4k. Monthly ops for 1k qps sustained ~ $60k - $85k depending on reserved discounts and embedding proportion. I'll produce a detailed breakout after the run.

alex (security): If PHI is present we must use Private deployment with customer-managed KMS and signed DPA. Lead time for KMS onboarding typically 8-12 business days after we have the service principal and IP allowlist. If Stormhold can postpone PHI runs, we can run non-PHI tests earlier.

oliver (stormhold): We can postpone PHI acceptance to the Private window. Proceed with Dedicated tests first. Melissa from our security team will DM you, alex.

run-bot: run started (id: sh-2034)  artifacts -> s3://perf-stormhold/sh-2034/  warmup in progress (ETA 20m)

jo (perf): Warmup snapshot: 180 qps on rwd-7b p95 ~175ms p99 ~410ms GPU util ~70%. rwd-3b-quant p95 ~195ms p99 ~460ms. Embedding path hitting ~2k vect/s on dedicated nodes.

run-bot: sustain phase complete. Artifacts: s3://perf-stormhold/sh-2034/results.csv, s3://perf-stormhold/sh-2034/latency-heatmaps.png. Summary: sustained 500 qps for 60m; aggregate p95 = 208ms (rwd-7b), p99 = 490ms, avg latency = 102ms. Worker preempt test caused p99 spike to 1.2s for ~90s, then recovered. Embedding spike had a 0.6% transient error increase.

maria (sales): Thanks team. Kai/Jo please prepare: 1) one-page acceptance checklist (metrics + pass/fail rules), 2) 1-page cost summary (72h run + monthly 1k qps range), 3) short fallback behavior note (what happens if Dedicated degrades). I'll attach to the procurement packet.

ai (note): Follow up items: jo upload CSV+PNG, kai finalize runbook snippet and fallback policy, alex await DM from Melissa for KMS details. Closing thread once docs uploaded.
